riemann.declared_proposition: Let Xi(z)=xi(1/2+i z), and let S_n be its Taylor sections at zero. On the closed first exhaustion rectangles D_2^+ and D_2^-, Xi has no zero. Consequently, for each sign there exists an index n for which S_n has zero count zero in D_2^sign and satisfies sup_boundary|Xi-S_n|<inf_boundary|S_n|. This is an existential actual-Xi Rouché theorem, not an explicit interval certificate.
riemann.mathematical_argument: For z=x+i y, s=1/2+i z=(1/2-y)+i x. The upper closed rectangle maps to -3/2<=Re(s)<=0 and the lower one to 1<=Re(s)<=5/2. Every zero of the completed xi function is a nontrivial zeta zero and therefore has 0<Re(s)<1; xi(0)=xi(1)=1/2. Hence Xi is zero-free on both compact closures. If delta is its positive minimum modulus there, uniform Taylor convergence gives sup|Xi-S_n|<delta/3. Then inf|S_n|>=2delta/3, and Rouché gives the asserted zero count and strict boundary inequality.

collatz.declared_proposition: For every k>=1, the cyclic accelerated-Collatz valuation family w_k=1^k 2^(2k), including every cyclic rotation, passes both TICKET-196 scalar gates but cannot satisfy affine divisibility. Its denominator is D_k=32^k-27^k and its affine numerator is B_k=32^k+27^k-2*18^k. If D_k divided B_k, coprimality with 2*9^k would force D_k to divide 3^k-2^k, which is positive and strictly smaller than D_k, a contradiction.
collatz.mathematical_argument: Summing the first k valuation-one terms and the following 2k valuation-two terms as geometric series gives the displayed B_k. Then B_k-D_k=2*9^k*(3^k-2^k). The odd number D_k is coprime to 3, hence to 2*9^k, while 0<3^k-2^k<D_k. Divisibility is therefore impossible. A one-step rotation obeys 2^(v_0)B_rot=3B+D, so divisibility is rotation invariant.

goldbach.declared_proposition: Let Q be the odd proper-prime-power part of Lambda and let C(X)={even N<=X:(Q*Q)(N)>0}. Then |C(X)|=o(X). Indeed the number A(X) of odd proper prime powers is O(sqrt(X)/log(X)+X^(1/3)log(X))=O(sqrt(X)/log(X)), and every collision-supported target is a sum of two such powers, so |C(X)|<=A(X)^2=O(X/log(X)^2). Consequently the exact TICKET-196 overlap subtraction changes the old union envelope only on a density-zero set of even targets.
goldbach.mathematical_argument: For exponent two there are pi(sqrt X) choices. For exponents at least three, summing pi(X^(1/e)) over e<=log_3 X gives O(X^(1/3)log X). The standard Chebyshev prime-counting bound pi(y)=O(y/log y) gives A(X)=O(sqrt X/log X). The addition map from ordered proper-power pairs onto collision-supported targets gives |C(X)|<=A(X)^2. Dividing by the number of even targets proves density zero. Outside C(X), Q*Q(N)=0 exactly, so the corrected and uncorrected envelopes coincide.

twin_prime.declared_proposition: If two odd proper prime powers differ by two, their exponents are unequal. In particular no prime-square layer collision p^2,p^2+2=q^2 exists, and every Q(n)Q(n+2) overlap touches an exponent-at-least-three layer. Hence the TICKET-196 collision subtraction is O(X^(1/3)log X) in weighted dyadic mass under the classical Chebyshev bound, and it cannot cancel the leading prime-square contamination layer of order O(sqrt X log X).
twin_prime.mathematical_argument: If q^e-p^e=2 with q>p odd primes and e>=2, factorization gives (q-p)(q^(e-1)+q^(e-2)p+...+p^(e-1))=2. The first factor is at least two and the second is greater than one, a contradiction. Thus equal exponents are impossible, so at least one exponent is at least three. Charge every collision to such an endpoint; a fixed endpoint has at most two distance-two neighbours, so this charging has uniformly bounded multiplicity. The theta-layer bound for exponent at least three is O(X^(1/3)); the other logarithmic weight is at most log(2X+2).

reproducible_computation.no_go_scope: The theorem does not classify all mixed-exponent solutions of p^a+2=q^b and does not prove that only (25,27) occurs. More importantly, removing a lower-order overlap cannot create the missing parity-breaking lower bound for the full shift-two correlation.

twin_prime.logical_limit: The leading prime-square contamination remains untouched, and no parity-breaking lower bound is proved on infinitely many blocks.

first_rectangle_run_block_sparse_collisi.cross_problem_synthesis: The shared advance is quantifier localization: one bounded Xi region can close without RH content, one infinite Collatz order family can close without controlling all words, and exact overlap corrections can be too sparse or too low-order to supply universal correlation lower bounds. The next work must enter the critical strip, increase run complexity, and confront pointwise parity-sensitive errors.
